pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Apprentice plan at $10/month, the Artisan plan at $24/month, and the Maestro plan at $48/month [annual]… monthly… Apprentice $12/month, Artisan $30/month, Maestro $60/month… Free: 150 tokens/day"
pricingEvidence.note: One source reports that the tiers were renamed (Essential, Premium, Ultimate) in 2026.

nl.tagline: Veelzijdige AI-beeld- en videostudio, onderdeel van Canva
nl.description: Leonardo.Ai biedt beeld- en videogeneratie met veel stijlen en modellen, plus hulpmiddelen voor consistente personages, bewerken en opschalen. Populair bij makers en game-ontwikkelaars. Leonardo is sinds 2024 onderdeel van Canva.
bestFor: Veel stijlen uitproberen met een gratis dagtegoed
notFor: Wie één eenvoudig model zoekt zonder instellingen
limitations: Tokens per dag of maand; ongebruikte dagtokens vervallen

en.tagline: Versatile AI image and video studio, part of Canva
en.description: Leonardo.Ai offers image and video generation with many styles and models, plus tools for consistent characters, editing and upscaling. Popular with creators and game developers. Leonardo has been part of Canva since 2024.
bestFor: Trying many styles with a free daily allowance
notFor: People who want one simple model with no settings
limitations: Tokens per day or month; unused daily tokens expire
